title: F1597 Variational Consistency, Thermodynamic Integrity, and Nonmatching State Reconstruction Audit
finding: Independent variational consistency audit proves that the kinematic bulk-strain relations eps_bulk = (1-d)^p * eps and psi0_bulk = (1-d)^(2p) * psi0 violate Schwarz integrability against the frozen production UEL mechanical equilibrium (curl defect = 36% to 98% relative error, mean 67.2% for p=1; d(sigma)/dd != -dY_bulk/deps). The Clausius-Duhem inequality is violated because internal stress work does not equal energy dissipation rate plus strain energy storage rate. The formulation is strictly classified as an EXPERIMENTAL_HISTORY_SOURCE_ATTENUATION_STUDY, while the production UEL f42_mixed_uel.for (SHA-256 CE8D5EDCD2911DCB018BB15275271F874E7EA62B8FB48CF4A8297469A83ACDD6) remains bitwise frozen. Canonical nonmatching state transfer from Package 50 donor (5 um) to Candidate C2 receiver (1 um crack band) under canonical UEL equations isolates and clamps donor overshoot (d_raw=1.0021837 across 4 nodes to d<=1.0). Baseline frozen damage yields RF2 = 9.9785 N (+27.09% vs 7.8512 N) and fracture energy E_frac = 0.2987 mJ (+0.79% vs 0.2963 mJ), with mechanical residual 3.0e-15 kN, but un-equilibrated phase-field residual due to a 12.69x crack-tip strain energy surge (psi0+=659.10 vs donor H=51.93 kN/mm2). Coupled variational re-equilibration with active-set PDAS (zero healing = 0.0, min active multiplier = 0.0, mechanical residual = 3.0e-15 kN) triggers crack-tip unzipping without load incrementation, driving RF2 down to 0.3655 N (-95.34% deficit) and fracture energy to 0.3061 mJ (+3.30%). Transfer remains FAILED (-95.3% coupled / +27.1% frozen vs +-5.0% threshold) due to coarse-donor discretization error.
limitation: Coarse 5 um donor discretization lacks point-equilibrated crack-tip stresses, causing localized phase-field unzipping (-95.34% force deficit) under canonical re-equilibration. Heuristic bulk attenuation (4.14 N, -47.2%) violates Schwarz integrability and Clausius-Duhem thermodynamic consistency.
next_operation: Evaluate higher-resolution donor meshes (e.g. 2.5 um or 1.25 um) or compatible variational projection of crack-tip displacement gradients before nonmatching state transfer, preserving the frozen production UEL.
